response.sql: WITH per_tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(modindex) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall_avg FROM per_tel) SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_mod AS avg_modindex, p.avg_mod - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall, p.avg_mod / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall FROM per_tel p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_mod > o.overall_avg ORDER BY ratio_to_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes whose signals all have NULL modindex have no average and are excluded from the per-telescope set and from the overall mean of per-telescope averages.
Telescopes are taken from signals.telescref only (not the telescopes table), as the request says 'in the signals table'.
